abrupt d/c → w.draw sx - taper after chronic use
taper if long ↑dose use - fatigue, depression
+5 mg q wk; +2.5 mg q wk

content.text: Methylphenidate (Ritalin · Ritalin SR · Methylin · Metadate ER or CD · Concerta · Daytrana- patch)
-    MOA: block DAT/NET → ⍉DA/NE reuptake → ↑[DA/NE synaptic] (⍉ direct release - needs neuron firing; unlike amphetamine)
-    SE: priapism (urgent)    -    periph vasculopathy/Raynaud    -    fever    -    sz
-     Pt ed: swallow Concerta whole - ⍉ split/crush/chew
severe depression on w.draw    -    Hx substance abuse/alcoholism
Dexmethylphenidate (Focalin · Focalin XR): d-threo enantiomer of racemic methylphenidate

-    Clin Use: ↑alert/insomnia    -    ↓fatigue/appetite    -    3:1 d:l amphetamine salts    -    Tmax ~7 h (XR)
-    SE: C-2    -    CNS (weakness · dizziness · confusion · delirium · SI)    -    CV (arrhythmias · angina pain)    -    diarrhea
-    CI: HTN/CVD/AS    -    hyperthyroidism    -    Hx drug abuse    -    MAOI w.in 14D
-    BBW: C-2    -    drug dep    -    sudden death    -    serious ♡ effects
: enter sympathetic n. ending & displace stored catecholamine transmitter
